hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Corners protocol that applies asymmetric static LP fees per pool based on swap direction (corners token vs. paired token), takes a 20% protocol fee on each swap by manipulating BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and optionally runs an MEV protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
